newsitem.title: FRANCE: French blue-chip share index breaks through 2,700.
newsitem.headline: French blue-chip share index breaks through 2,700.

text.p: French shares rose by nearly 2.5 percent to break the 2,700 points barrier after strong rises fuelled by the futures market in the wake of the appointment of a left-wing government. Investors re-assured by the make-up of the government with Dominique Strauss-Kahn at Finance seen posing no threat to European monetary union and with a Communist minister at Transport.
* CAC-40 index up 66.46, or 2.52 percent, at 2,701.83 at 1044 GMT.
* CAC-40 June futures 2,681 vs 2,614 at Wednesday's close.
